listeningQuestions.audio: Morrie is being weakened by a severe illness.
opts: 莫里正被一场重病一点点拖垮。

listeningQuestions.audio: Once you learn how to die, you learn how to live.
opts: 一旦学会面对死亡,你就学会了如何生活。

listeningQuestions.audio: Happiness is found in simple things, not in luxury.
opts: 幸福在于简单的事物,而非奢华。

listeningQuestions.audio: A box of tissues will be needed to read this book.
opts: 读这本书会需要一盒纸巾。

listeningQuestions.audio: We should always keep in touch with good friends.
opts: 我们应当一直和好友保持联系。
他把秘密告诉了所有人。

listeningQuestions.audio: These lessons have been shared with readers around the world.
opts: 这些人生道理已被分享给世界各地的读者。

quizQuestions.q: Morrie was slowly ____ by a severe illness.
Although the book is about dying, it is not ____.
Morrie taught us to ____ what we already have.
Each fable ends with a short ____ that teaches a lesson.
So far, the book ____ into more than forty languages.
Right now, a new cover ____ for the next edition.
Despite ____ by illness, Morrie stayed cheerful.
Such wisdom must ____ down to the young.

opts: 莫里从窗口观察着每一次季节的变化。
quizQuestions.audio: Morrie observed every change of season from his window.

opts: 彼此相爱,否则就会消亡。

reading.passage: After he became seriously ill, Morrie decided to share everything he had learned about love and life. Every Tuesday his former student came to visit him, and their honest talks were later turned into a book that has moved millions of readers.
reading.passageCn: 在病重之后,莫里决定把自己关于爱与人生所学的一切分享出来。每个星期二,他从前的学生都来探望他,而他们坦诚的谈话后来被写成了一本打动了千百万读者的书。

questions.q: Why did Morrie decide to share his ideas?
opts: Because he wanted to pass on what he had learned.
Because he wanted to become rich.

questions.q: What were their Tuesday talks turned into?

writing.prompt: Write 3-4 sentences about a book or person that changed the way you live. Say what happened and what you learned, using at least two passive sentences (e.g. The book was written by…, I was reminded that…).
writing.promptCn: 用3-4句话写一本书或一个人如何改变了你的生活方式:发生了什么、你学到了什么,至少用两个被动句(如 The book was written by…, I was reminded that…)。

lines.text: I just finished Tuesdays with Morrie. I thought it would be sad, but I feel full of hope.
lines.cn: 我刚读完《相约星期二》。本以为会很悲伤,结果我满怀希望。

lines.text: I felt the same. Morrie was very ill, yet he was never pessimistic.
lines.cn: 我也是。莫里病得很重,却从不悲观。

lines.text: My favourite idea is that our values should be chosen by ourselves, not by society.
lines.cn: 我最喜欢的一点是:我们的价值观应由自己选择,而不是由社会决定。

lines.text: Mine is simpler: we must keep in touch with the good people we love.
lines.cn: 我喜欢的更简单:要和我们所爱的好人保持联系。
